title: Docker Build Plan
description: A structured description of a Dockerfile/CI build design, so this skill's Quality Gates (BuildKit, layer ordering, cache mounts, multi-stage, secrets, nonroot, multi-arch) can be checked deterministically by scripts/docker_build_audit.mjs.

buildkitEnabled.description: True if the build runs under BuildKit (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 or buildx).

copyOrder.description: Whether the Dockerfile copies the lockfile/manifest and installs before copying source (manifest-first), or does COPY . . before the install (source-first — busts the cache every commit).

runtimeLanguage.description: The runtime stack, which sets the image-size budget and the QEMU-emulation rule.

cacheMountForPackageManager.description: True if the install step uses RUN --mount=type=cache on the package-manager directory.

multiStage.description: True if the Dockerfile separates build stage(s) from a slim runtime stage.

finalImageSizeMB.description: Measured size of the final image in MB; gates are <= 300MB for Node/Python and <= 100MB for Go/Rust.

dockerignorePresent.description: True if a .dockerignore excludes node_modules, .git, dist, and .env.

ciColdBuilds.description: True if CI runners start with an empty local build cache (e.g. ephemeral GitHub Actions runners).

registryCacheConfigured.description: True if CI uses --cache-to/--cache-from type=registry (mode=max) so cold runners pull cache layers.

secretsHandling.description: How build-time credentials reach the build. ARG/ENV persist in image metadata and are forbidden.

runtimeUser.description: The USER of the runtime stage.

noCacheFlagInCI.description: True if the CI build passes --no-cache by default.

targetsArm64.description: True if linux/arm64 is a build target.

arm64Builder.description: How arm64 images are built: a native arm64 builder, QEMU emulation, or not at all.
